## Three Product Directions

```{dot}
//| label: fig-products
//| fig-cap: "Three paths to market — each builds on the previous"
//| fig-width: 6
//| fig-height: 3
digraph G {
  bgcolor="transparent"
  rankdir=TB
  graph [ranksep=0.45, nodesep=0.5]
  node [style=filled, fillcolor="#2c3035", color="#4a9eda",
        fontcolor="#f8f9fa", fontname="Arial", fontsize=10,
        shape=box, width=2.0, height=0.5, margin="0.12,0.08"]
  edge [color="#6c757d", penwidth=1.4]

  A [label="Diagnostic API\nB2B SaaS\nFree → Paid", fillcolor="#1a4a3a", color="#00bc8c"]
  B [label="Certified Fine-Tuning\nPlatform partnerships\nGuaranteed robustness", fillcolor="#375a7f", color="#f0ad4e"]
  C [label="Compliance Tooling\nAudit-ready reports\nRegulated industries", fillcolor="#375a7f", color="#f0ad4e"]

  A -> B -> C
}
```

### 1. Training-Time Diagnostic API (B2B SaaS)

- **Wedge:** `sart.diagnose(model, train_data, val_data)` → per-sample shortcut report
- **Entry:** Free diagnostic tier → paid correction (reweighting + surgery)
- **First customer profile:** ML teams at Series B+ startups who fine-tune and have experienced production failures

### 2. Robustness-Certified Fine-Tuning (Platform Play)

- **Wedge:** Partner with fine-tuning providers (Together AI, Anyscale, Fireworks)
- **Value:** "Your fine-tuned model, guaranteed X% robustness on shifted inputs"

### 3. Compliance & Audit Tooling (Regulated Industries)

- **Wedge:** Quantitative robustness metrics → audit-ready reports
- **Entry point:** Fintech companies needing SR 11-7 compliance evidence
- **Driver:** EU AI Act, FDA AI/ML guidance require demonstrable robustness

```{dot}
digraph G {
  bgcolor="transparent"
```

```{dot}
  edge [color="#6c757d", penwidth=1.4]

  Free [label="Free Tier\nDiagnostic API\nSmall models", fillcolor="#2c3035", color="#495057"]

  Ent [label="Enterprise\nAnnual contract\nSLA + support", fillcolor="#1a4a3a", color="#00bc8c"]

  Free -> Pro -> Ent

```

| Tier | Model | Target |
|------|-------|--------|
| **Free** | Diagnostic API, limited model size | Individual ML engineers, small teams |
| **Pro** | Full diagnostic + correction, usage-based | Growth-stage ML teams |
| **Enterprise** | Annual contract, SLA, dedicated support | Regulated industries, large platforms |

## Market Pain Points

```{dot}
//| label: fig-pain
//| fig-cap: "Current workarounds all share the same flaw: they don't scale"
//| fig-width: 6
//| fig-height: 3.5
digraph G {
  bgcolor="transparent"
  rankdir=TB
  graph [ranksep=0.4, nodesep=0.5]
  node [style=filled, fillcolor="#2c3035", color="#4a9eda",
        fontcolor="#f8f9fa", fontname="Arial", fontsize=10,
        shape=box, width=2.0, height=0.5, margin="0.12,0.08"]
  edge [style=invis]

  A [label="Manual Red-Teaming\nExpensive\n& incomplete", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]
  B [label="Ad Hoc Eval Suites\nNot standardized\nnot training-integrated", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]

  C [label="Conservative HPs\nSacrifices\nadaptation quality", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]
  D [label="Data Filtering\nRequires knowing\nshortcuts in advance", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]

  { rank=same; A; B }
  { rank=same; C; D }

  A -> C
  B -> D
}
```

| Pain Point | Current Workaround | Why It Fails |
|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| Models fail on edge cases | Manual red-teaming | Expensive, incomplete, doesn't scale |
| No robustness metrics for auditors | Ad hoc evaluation suites | Not standardized, not training-integrated |
| Fine-tuning degrades quality | Conservative hyperparameters | Sacrifices adaptation quality |
| Unknown shortcuts in data | Data cleaning / filtering | Requires knowing shortcuts in advance |
